subject.title: Anthropic setup-token onboarding path has multiple failure modes (docs gap, credential propagation, multi-agent sync)

question: Should Anthropic setup-token/manual token auth rely on main-store runtime read-through, physically sync static token profiles to sibling agent stores, or change the setup-token route to steer users away from this credential shape?
rationale: The remaining fix changes how sensitive provider credentials are copied, inherited, or validated across agent stores, and current main already has read-through behavior that may conflict with a physical-copy fix.

options.title: Prefer read-through plus validation
options.body: Keep the main-store inheritance model, improve prompt/docs, and add post-write/readback validation plus doctor guidance without copying token material to every sibling store.

options.title: Token-only sibling sync
options.body: Physically sync only Anthropic static token profiles to sibling agent stores with tests, while keeping OAuth refresh material explicitly non-portable.

options.title: Deprecate setup-token onboarding
options.body: Keep setup-token supported only as an advanced/manual path and steer normal users to Claude CLI reuse or Anthropic API keys.

recommendation.title: Prefer read-through plus validation
recommendation.body: Keep the main-store inheritance model, improve prompt/docs, and add post-write/readback validation plus doctor guidance without copying token material to every sibling store.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent history on the affected auth write paths and already reviewed a related auth-file propagation PR for security concerns.
